translation.name: GOD ETER AGERKE NAMDERASEM TUMA YENBO

book.name: MATYU
book.title: MATYU Matyu ere bas rasem Tuma Yenbo.

content: Herot ere abom, Jisas ere ok wirubetem sam tame, Jon.
Ete yabel Galili provinsri apeilake tame, Herot, ere Jisas eri nenbetemkap metem.
Metem, ere eri yaku kere tame emne etep wom. Ete tame ere tame emne baptais ok wirubetem tame Jon. Kiyi an erne wak regem, ere selek sene wayen mure peten ere rigrabe ek nenbe. Etep wom.
Jon eri sam tuma gwopkap. Kiyi Herot eter ere Jon erne keresukun kepke peiken ake yaperke won wurim. Bepou berai. Eri mase, Filip, eteri ta, Herodias etet te erne etep wom.
Kiyi Jon ere Herot erne etep wobetem. Ne neri mase eri ta panem, e yaper.

Etep wobetem, Herot ere pap wayem, ere Jon erne pen sate wom. Tatame nogwape eme wobetem. Jon ere God eri tuma wusoube tame, ere tame yenbo. Etep wobetem. Herot ere emri tuma metem, ere erne pen sate me akem.

Yabel wuri kau tame eme yan Herot eterken wurisubuk siyewom, eme Herot erne nawo te warwiyim yabel abom, eke eme awos eisau nenem. Nenem, Herodias teri yen te emri borke teten yage taibetem, Herot ere metekwasem.
Metekwasem, ere tene etep wom. Nema nene metekwasbe. Etepkap, ne ane be wos nene newote wote, an nene newote. An beke yikwokwo. An nene newote nenbe.

Etep womke, yen te teri nawo tene yin tuma wometlan etep wom. Ere ane wos newote woye. An erne be woske womette? Te sene woran Herot erne nawo teri wom tuma erne etep wom. Tatame emne baptais ok wirubetem tame, Jon, ne erne wak regte, eri tare rewok yewo sen yan, ane ek peterate.

Etep womke, Herot ere pap yaper metem. Ere Jon erne wak regte mo wom, ere abolawoyim. Ere etep abom. Tatame nogwape eme arenken awos abe, eme aren tene woye tuma metye. An tene beke yikwokwote. Etep abon, ere etep wom. Teri woye wos kem etep nente.
Etep wom, ere yaku kere tame won ake yaperke yin eme Jon erne wak regem.
Regem, eme eri tare sen yan rewok rasem mungu ta yen tene newom. Newom, yen te peten sen yin nawo tene peteram.
Etep temke, Jon eri wakse eme yan eri kupa peten sele mei peren meike rasem. Sele meike peren rasen, eme sene yin Jisas erne wusowum.
Jisas ere tame nogwape (500) emne awos newon am.
Jisas ere ete tuma metemke, ere ete kom mesginin pere peten akeite emik yim. Ere kena wiwi, ere tameken berai emik yim. Yim, tatame eme etep metem, eme emri ake mesginin erne lan yim. Eme tewok yim.
Yim, yuri Jisas ere yin gayin lam, ere tatame nogwape emne etek lam. Lam, ere emne kobo kenake lam, ere etemri kapoyi kei tatame emne eyarem.
Perpe eri anepoi tame eme yan erne etep wom. Yabel warbe. Gwo emi e tameken berai, tatame eme awos mak pette? Ne emne won yite, eme komke yin awos tukte.
Jisas ere awosein etep wom. Eme beke nenteke yite. Kerem, kem emne awos newon ate.
Eme erne etep wom. Nema awos nogwape berai. Geil ep yekwo let, omyen sok peswou tetan.
Ere etep wom. Ne ane gwok sen yate.

Sen yan, ere tatame emne etep wom. Kem selke si. Simke, ere geil ep yekwo let, omyen sok pes peten ere le nelke nerulan God erne pir won ere geilken omyenken pekayewom. Pekayewom, ere eri anepoi tame emne newom, eme peten tatame emne newopit pete yan eme am.
Akei an se kir temke, tep tem, eme peten kworasare ep yekwo let ep yekwo let tewo bor pes kei (12-pela) etek yewon pelawon yam.
Sitirin awos am tamewou eme sarem, eme nogwapewai (500). Yenta emne eme beke sar.
Jisas ere peik kupa ok luke yam.
Jisas ere anepoi tame emne etep wom. Kem perek waren peik keraruke kiyi taresin yite. Yimke, ere tatame emne etemri komke sene won yim.
Yimke, ere kena wiwi kowke yawom, ere Apei erken tuma namdete yawom. Yabel warbetem, ere etek kena wiwi temenem.
Temenem, teketemke, pere nebule wuri anepoi tame eme etek siyewomenem, eme peik mei borke temenemke, marye ek yam, ok sare pere tarek tegilmibetem.
Sene ei berate nenbetemke, Jisas ere ok luke yin ere anepoi tame etemken tete yibetem.
Yibetemke, eme etep lam, eme kenake aken taye pitin etep wom. E peikri sikilewas. Eke eme aken taye pitem.
Jisas ere emne etep wom. Kem mane akte. Gwo aren. Kem mane akte.
Pita ere erne awosein etep wom. Aneyen, kap neren seken, ne ane wotek, an ok luke nene yan late.
Jisas ere etep wom. Ne epe ya. Pita ere pere mesginin ere ok luke yin Jisas erne lam.
Yim, sene ere marye lan akem. Akem, ere okke waren abetem, ere agetage Jisas erne tem. Aneyen, ne ane kobo la. Ne ane nenewayete. Etep wom.
Agetage Jisas ere erne let tayemke, erne keresukun erne etep wom. Ne ane kenawaike beke abo. Beke ne pap pes ten me akbe?
Etep womke, epe perek yin waremke, marye ere beyem.
Beyem, perek temenem tame eme eri mure etep lam, eme erne sukye woran etep wom. Sekenwai. Ne Keryen God Eteri Yen. Etep wom.
Jisas ere rekebuk tatame emne Genesaret komke eyarem.
Eme peik kupa pukeyin keraruke woi wun, eme Genesaret komke yin gayim.
Gayim, ete komri tatame eme erne lam, eme etep wom. E Jisas. Etep womke, eme kom mekinri tatame emne tuma wopitim, eme emri rekebuk tatame emne panen yam.

Panen yam, rekebuk tatame eme erne etep wometem. Nema neri warten tame oub megke kerelate. Nema kerelate, nema yenbo tete. Etep wom, ete tatame eme eri warmenem tame oub megke kerelam, eme akei yenbo tem.
